news.title: Rookie Roman Kantserov posts first NHL hat trick in Chicago Blackhawks' victory

news.title: Roman Kantserov scores his first NHL hat trick in the Blackhawks’ 6-3 win over the Canucks

news.title: Jake Oettinger stops 33 shots for league-best fifth shutout in Stars' 1-0 win over Penguins
news.ruTitle: Джейк Эттингер отразил 33 броска, став лучшим пятым голом в лиге в победе "Старз" над "Пингвинз" со счетом 1:0.
news.description: — Jake Oettinger stopped a season-high 34 shots and had his NHL-leading fifth shutout of the season, Joel Kiviranta scored a second-period goal and the Dallas Stars beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 1-0 on Sunday night for their fifth straight win.
